title: Same-campaign kelp-cover retrieval from Sentinel-2 and Pleiades Neo with the physics pipeline
status_note: User authorised execution on 2026-11-02. This local development protocol and code hashes were fixed before new real-cover scores. Prior label use is disclosed. Continuous accuracy, spectral compatibility and coverage are reported; no application release threshold was supplied.
question: How accurately can the physics pipeline estimate the kelp percentage cover observed by divers in each matched Sesimbra campaign, first from Sentinel-2 and separately from Pleiades Neo? Does the imagery add information beyond depth alone?
why: In v1 the QAA fit over the Pleiades Neo deep-water reference raised plausibility flags on both dates (red_reference_selected(655nm), bbp_555_implausible; Kd(486) 1.32 and 1.26 m-1), so the registered rule left the corrected branch unavailable (archive/out/optics-reference/runs/20260920T115500-a5823dc0e7cc/reference_iops.json).

attenuation_source.pixel: nearest product-valid water pixel within 5 km and +/-3 days; nearest day first, then nearest pixel; earlier day wins date ties
attenuation_source.quality_checks: reviewed LAND=1 schema; flags=0; positive finite in-range KD490; finite nonnegative in-range uncensored uncertainty; expected physical units
attenuation_source.qualification_status: Product-qualified candidate used conditionally for this development test; reef representativeness unestablished.

spectral_extension.shape: E5s median non-water absorption and particulate backscatter (forced-560 QAA, Sentinel-2, 24 December 2025 and 22 February 2026)
spectral_extension.magnitude: one factor on that shape, chosen so that the Lee et al. (2005) Kd(490) of the scaled IOPs equals the CMEMS value
spectral_extension.library: Repository-pinned kelpobserve.coastal; source hashes recorded under execution_code_sha256.

fallback_rule.rule: Only the product-qualified same-day fixed KD490 neighbour. Missing source or metadata stops that run; no pixel/date fallback selected by performance. BBP/CDM not jointly fitted.
fallback_rule.note: This experiment consumes the fixed qualified same-day source record directly; the older general-purpose choose() stub remains unchanged.

known_limits: The product grid is nominally 1 km. The selected water pixel is 0.891 km from the reef; only one eligible pixel lies within 1 km. Coastal adjacency and shallow-bottom contributions remain possible, and the daily bin does not establish coincidence with an image overpass.
A correct attenuation does not remove the radiometric residual of 0.01 to 0.04 that r1 to r6 found as large as the seabed contrast; the correction amplifies that residual by exp(K z).

Repaired winter CMEMS candidates are 0.0880 m-1 (24 December 2025) and 0.2412 m-1 (22 February 2026); the earlier 0.090/0.271 values came from a LAND-flagged pixel. Winter QAA is another remote retrieval, not independent in-water validation.
The fixed water pixel varies across the +/-3-day windows. Spatial and temporal neighbours are correlated, and agreement cannot rule out shared retrieval bias.

amendments.kind: development input repair and qualification; no habitat scoring
amendments.change: Exclude LAND and invalid product values; require reviewed quality metadata; audit seven frozen-subset dates with spatial, fixed-pixel temporal and uncertainty diagnostics.
amendments.history: All seven previous finite-only candidates carried LAND=1. Historical output files and the frozen subset are retained.
amendments.outcome: Seven same-day candidates at 0.891 km; all candidate_only for reef application. No uncertainty cap adopted. Fallback choice and r7 outcome criteria remain open.

amendments.kind: User-directed priority and evaluation scope; no new cover scores
amendments.previous_question: With an attenuation taken from outside the image, does the water-column-corrected branch, unavailable in v1, predict July cover better than depth alone?
amendments.change: Prioritise direct physics-based cover estimates against campaign-matched field observations, Sentinel-2 first and Pleiades Neo separately. July and September each use their own labels. Transfer is deferred.
amendments.history: v1-r6 outputs and their registered decisions remain unchanged. Existing corrected-reflectance regressions and simulation oracles do not constitute the proposed direct field-cover retrieval.
amendments.status: Draft; implementation choices and numerical criteria remain open.

amendments.kind: Pre-score development freeze after user authorisation
amendments.change: Fix direct spectral cover retrieval, separate campaigns, V1 primary/V0 sensitivity, fixed water source, borrowed endmembers, residual tolerances, sensitivity grid, spatially purged baselines and continuous evaluation.
amendments.criteria: No application-derived cover-error or coverage requirement was provided. No map-ready decision is made. The 0.001 rhos compatibility tolerance and 0.0005/0.002 sensitivities are diagnostic and do not establish kelp-cover accuracy.
amendments.implementation_validation: 19 focused tests before scoring, including agreement with the library forward model, exact-input recovery, ambiguity, incompatible spectra and spatial leakage checks.
amendments.provenance: Registration/code hashes and input checksums stored in each new run. No commit implied; prior outputs unchanged.

local_cover_evaluation.priority: Establish local cover retrieval on existing campaign matchups before spatial or temporal transfer.
local_cover_evaluation.target: Observed Saccorhiza polyschides percentage cover; occurrence is secondary. Spectral mixture fraction is a candidate estimate whose relationship to diver cover must be evaluated.
local_cover_evaluation.campaigns: July and September evaluated separately against their own observations. June remains in the inventory with its scene and reference eligibility; no transfer prediction fills an unavailable campaign.

scene_order.date_offset: 5 days before deep dives on 7 July; 6 days before shallow dives on 8 July
scene_order.status: r1 partial-support diagnostic: 14 of 18 cells; v1 scene unavailable under its coverage rule. Any new supported-subset analysis must be declared explicitly.

scene_order.date_offset: 1-2 days before plausible survey dates 1-2 September
scene_order.status: Existing clean candidate; use September observations independently of July.

scene_order.date_offset: Same day as shallow dives; one day after deep dives
scene_order.status: Native multispectral and common 10 m support; quantify existing radiometric limits.

scene_order.date_offset: 1-2 days after plausible survey dates 1-2 September
scene_order.status: Native multispectral and common 10 m support; September assessed against its own observations.

primary_method.retrieval: Fixed Lee model in observation space for two-endmember spectral cover, 0.1 percentage-point search grid; blue/green effective benthic reflectance retained as an unclipped diagnostic. The exact implementation and sensitivity rules are in execution_protocol.
primary_method.calibration: No endmember, water parameter, offset, mask or acceptance threshold selected using evaluation cover. The r4 true-endmember oracle is a simulation control and cannot serve as the real-data method unchanged.
primary_method.interpretation: Kelp is a three-dimensional canopy. Effective benthic reflectance and spectral mixture fraction are distinct from measured planar cover until the field comparison supports that interpretation.
primary_method.secondary: Corrected-reflectance-plus-cover-regression may be reported as a separate calibrated branch; it does not replace the direct physical retrieval test.

local_cover_evaluation.water_inputs: Use frozen, product-qualified Copernicus data as candidate constraints with explicit assumptions. KD490-scaled winter spectral shape is an existing candidate, not measured summer IOPs. BBP443 and CDM443 require mutual consistency checks before joint use. A production OceanStream deployment is not a prerequisite for this local test.

evaluation.reference: Compare with campaign-specific diver observations at the declared sampling footprint. Multiple quadrats in an S2 cell form a sampled mean; they do not establish complete-pixel truth.
evaluation.spatial_independence: Any fitted cover calibration or baseline uses within-campaign leave-one-transect-out evaluation with shared image cells excluded from training when represented in held-out data. Report the resulting sample counts and limited spatial replication.
evaluation.controls: Compare direct retrieval, raw-spectral and depth-only fitted baselines on identical eligible units; retain a training-mean baseline. All are scored against diver cover. Depth-only controls the information available from bathymetry.
evaluation.metrics: Cover MAE and signed bias in percentage points, paired differences against depth-only, shallow/deep results, uncertainty or sensitivity ranges, counts and coverage of accepted retrievals, with every rejection reason.
evaluation.depth: Retain both observed depth strata, including deeper transects. Report depth-stratified retrieval support and performance; do not select a 10 m cutoff from the scores.
evaluation.availability: Separate scene unavailable, retrieval unreliable or ambiguous, and a supported retrieval with poor cover accuracy. Missing or rejected retrievals are never zero cover.
evaluation.transfer: July-to-September prediction and other-site transfer are outside the primary comparison.
evaluation.evidence_status: Development analysis: these field labels have already been inspected and used in prior experiments.
evaluation.claim_separation: Report absolute local cover accuracy and added information beyond depth as separate findings. Adequate absolute agreement without improvement over depth does not establish optical kelp detection.
evaluation.application_threshold: Unspecified by intended use; no map-ready binary verdict. Continuous metrics and predeclared spectral compatibility are the outputs.

execution_protocol.water_magnitude_scenarios: KD490 * (1 + step * provider_percentage_error/100), step=-1,0,+1; no confidence-level interpretation
execution_protocol.depth_scenario_basis: Declared sensitivity bracket given prior 1-4 m depth-label/lidar residuals; no calibrated depth distribution. Canopy-height effects are only approximated by effective-depth perturbation.
execution_protocol.tolerance_basis: Diagnostic reflectance compatibility: earlier r3 clean-scene adjacent-pixel scales were about 0.0009-0.0010 rhos. This fixed tolerance is not validated sensor error, a probability, or an application cover threshold.
execution_protocol.comparison: Equal-unit MAE/bias/RMSE on identical units with baseline predictions; supplementary equal-transect paired differences with descriptive bootstrap and leave-one-group-out range.
execution_protocol.primary_spectra: E5s sensor-convolved pooled taxon-balanced kelp median; equal mean of turf/coralline_crust/red_foliose medians. Fixed before scoring. Spectral quartiles applied coherently per class are stress scenarios, not measured joint draws.
execution_protocol.bands: Blue and green only, actual raster centres for water coefficients and sensor-convolved E5s endmembers. Centre-band approximation retained explicitly. No red/NIR seabed information assumed at these depths.
execution_protocol.selection: Unchanged r1 pixel/area masks. Supported-subset analysis allowed despite v1 whole-scene coverage failure. Mixed-transect and mixed-stratum cells excluded; all exclusions reported.
execution_protocol.fallback: Only the product-qualified same-day fixed KD490 neighbour. Missing source or metadata stops that run; no pixel/date fallback selected by performance. BBP/CDM not jointly fitted.
execution_protocol.application_verdict: Continuous development results only. No application cover-error or minimum-coverage threshold has been specified; no map-ready claim. A close best fit must not be presented as a valid retrieval when nominal reflectance compatibility fails.
execution_protocol.registration_policy: Protocol and code locked in run files before any new real-cover score. Subsequent corrections retain failed runs and an explicit amendment. Old registrations and outputs unchanged.

implementation_corrections.failure: Summary of an empty compatible subset passed an object-dtype array to numpy.isfinite. Run stopped after the first group; no completed result table was emitted.
implementation_corrections.repair: Coerce scoring arrays to float; handle empty compatible comparisons. Added regression test. Import-order and immediate-lambda lint fixes have no scientific effect.
